name: Singapore
prevalence_note: ScamShield, SPF & MAS 2025-2026: SPF/MAS/ICA/MinLaw government official impersonation (English & Mandarin), fake WeChat/Alipay/UnionPay '百万保障' subscription screen-sharing scams, 'fake friend' PayNow calls, Singpass/WhatsApp remote-access tech support, and stock mentor chat groups dominate.
cross_border_note: Overseas scam syndicates call in English, Mandarin, Malay, and Tamil using foreign prefixes, SIM-box local numbers, or WhatsApp video calls; under IMDA anti-scam directives, Singapore telcos block or prepend '+65' to unauthenticated international calls spoofing local Singapore numbers.

scams.name: Government Officials Impersonation Scam (SPF / MAS / ICA / MinLaw)
scams.name_en: Fake SPF, MAS, ICA, or MinLaw official accusing recipient of money laundering
scams.signals_en: Caller claims to represent a Singapore bank, SPF, MAS, MinLaw, ICA, or IMDA, accusing the recipient of money laundering or Singpass/SIM misuse and demanding transfers via PayNow or cash/gold handover for investigation.
scams.legit_en: Singapore government officials (SPF, MAS, MinLaw, ICA) never ask the public to transfer money over a phone call, disclose Singpass or banking credentials, install unofficial apps, or transfer bank calls directly to police.
bait_tactics: Sorry ah, I'm on the MRT underground right now and the line keeps cutting off—can you repeat your division name slowly?
Hold on, my bank account has the Money Lock feature turned on so I cannot transfer anything by phone anyway; let me check at the branch later.
I don't have my IC with me right now, maybe I call back through the official ScamShield helpline when I reach home?

scams.name: 假冒新加坡警察部队（SPF）／金管局（MAS）／移民局华语诈骗
scams.name_en: Mandarin-language fake SPF, MAS, MinLaw, or ICA official demanding safe-account audit
scams.signals_en: Mandarin-speaking caller poses as SPF, MAS, MinLaw, ICA, or Mainland police claiming a bank card or mobile line under the victim's name is tied to cross-border money laundering, demanding video interrogation, secrecy, or transfers to a 'safety account'.
scams.legit_en: Singapore government officers never conduct Mandarin WhatsApp video interrogations, show warrant badges over chat apps, or demand fund transfers for asset clearance.
bait_tactics: 不好意思啊，我现在在地铁隧道里面信号断断续续听不清楚，你可以慢慢重念一次部门名称吗？
等一下，我的储蓄户口已经开了银行锁钱功能，手机上根本转不出钱，不如我下班亲自去邻里警局问清楚。
我现在人在巴刹买菜没带老花眼镜，看不清手机画面，你先等我慢慢走回家再说。

scams.name: 假冒微信／支付宝／银联客服取消「百万保障」屏幕共享诈骗
scams.name_en: Mandarin fake WeChat, Alipay, or UnionPay 'Million-Dollar Guarantee' cancellation & screen-sharing scam
scams.signals_en: Caller in Mandarin poses as WeChat, Alipay, or UnionPay support claiming a '百万保障' (Million-Dollar Guarantee) policy is expiring and will deduct monthly fees unless canceled via WhatsApp screen sharing, online banking login, or fake MAS video verification.
scams.legit_en: WeChat, Alipay, and UnionPay never phone Singapore residents to cancel '百万保障', ask for WhatsApp screen sharing, or transfer calls to MAS officials.
bait_tactics: 奇怪咧，我的微信根本没有绑定任何新加坡银行卡，它要从哪里扣钱？你帮我查清楚是哪家银行先。
我的手机银行刚才密码按错几次锁住了，屏幕一直在转圈圈，要不我自己去分行柜台问一下？
我不会弄那个屏幕共享按钮，等我孙子晚上放学回来帮我看一下手机好吗？

scams.name: Fake Friend Call & Urgent PayNow Scam
scams.name_en: Fake friend with lost phone asking recipient to guess their voice and PayNow money urgently
scams.signals_en: An unknown caller warmly asks if the recipient recognizes their voice, claiming they lost their mobile phone and switched numbers before asking for an urgent PayNow transfer to a third-party account.
scams.legit_en: Real friends, relatives, and business contacts should always be verified by calling their previously saved phone number directly, and they will not demand urgent PayNow transfers to unfamiliar third-party accounts.
bait_tactics: Wait ah, your voice sounds quite different today—which primary school or reservist unit did we know each other from?
My daily PayNow limit is set super low and my hardware token is at home, so I really cannot send anything right now.

scams.name: Tech Support & WhatsApp Screen-Sharing Remote Access Scam
scams.name_en: Tech support or platform security caller requesting remote access, Singpass, or digital token approval
scams.signals_en: Posing as software, bank, or Singpass helpdesk staff, the caller claims the recipient's computer or phone is compromised and asks for remote access, WhatsApp screen sharing, or digital token approval.
scams.legit_en: Reputable technology companies, Singpass, and Singapore banks never make unsolicited virus-removal calls, ask for screen sharing, or instruct customers to approve digital banking tokens.
bait_tactics: Oh, this laptop belongs to my company IT department and blocks all downloads without an administrator password.
My home fibre broadband just dropped connection so the browser won't load anything—let me bring the device to the service centre tomorrow.
Why would fixing a computer alert need me to open my bank app? Wait ah, let me ask my nephew who works in IT first.

scams.name: Investment Chat Group Mentor Scam
scams.name_en: Investment learning community and stock mentor chat group scam
scams.signals_en: Following up on online ads or unsolicited outreach, the caller claims to represent a brokerage mentor group offering guaranteed stock allocations via an exclusive app and PayNow deposits.
scams.legit_en: MAS-licensed financial institutions in Singapore are verifiable on the MAS Financial Institutions Directory, never guarantee risk-free returns, and never ask clients to wire investment funds to personal accounts.
bait_tactics: Sounds interesting, can you spell out your MAS representative licence details slowly so I can check the MAS Financial Institutions Directory first?
All my savings are tied up in CPF and fixed deposits right now, so I have zero spare cash to open any new trading account.

scams.name: Penipuan Menyamar Pegawai SPF / MAS / Singpass & PayNow
scams.name_en: Malay-language fake SPF, MAS, or Singpass official demanding safe-account PayNow transfer
scams.signals_en: Malay-speaking caller poses as SPF, MAS, or bank security claiming the resident's Singpass or bank account was misused, pressuring them to share their screen or transfer savings via PayNow to a 'safe account'.
scams.legit_en: SPF, MAS, and Singapore banks never instruct Malay-speaking residents to transfer money to a safe account, share Singpass OTPs, or turn on WhatsApp screen sharing.
bait_tactics: Maaf encik, isyarat telefon dalam lif blok HDB saya ni putus-putus, boleh ulang nama jabatan perlahan-lahan?
Akaun simpanan saya sudah dikunci dengan ciri Money Lock, jadi saya akan semak sendiri di cawangan bank esok pagi.

scams.name: சிங்கப்பூர் காவல்துறை / MAS / Singpass அதிகாரி போல் நடிக்கும் மோசடி
scams.name_en: Tamil-language fake SPF, MAS, or Singpass official demanding safe-account transfer
scams.signals_en: Tamil-speaking caller impersonates SPF, MAS, or a local Singapore bank alleging identity misuse or money laundering and demanding digital-token approval, WhatsApp screen sharing, or transfer to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Singapore police, MAS, and local banks never ask residents over the phone for Singpass OTPs, banking token approvals, or transfers to external safe accounts.
bait_tactics: மன்னிக்கவும், இப்போது ரயிலில் செல்வதால் இணைப்பு சரியாகக் கேட்கவில்லை, உங்கள் துறை பெயரை மெதுவாகச் சொல்ல முடியுமா?
என் வங்கி கணக்கில் பணப் பாதுகாப்பு பூட்டு உள்ளது, நான் நேரில் வங்கி கிளைக்குச் சென்று சரிபார்த்துக் கொள்கிறேன்.
